title: Entitled Woman Throws Tantrum After Bar Fight with Ex-Boyfriend
description:
A Florida woman was arrested after allegedly refusing to leave a bar in Destin, Florida during spring break. Police took Annabelle Bass, 22, into custody after bar security and multiple officers repeatedly asked her to leave, according to the Okaloosa County Sheriff’s Department. Bass can be seen on body camera video trying to weasel her way back into the bar, but after multiple chances were given to the 22-year-old to leave, she ended up on the ground and in cuffs. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
